description: Detect stale resident openagents-environment daemon by executable path via lsof instead of ps comm in install.sh.

steps.send: In `apps/openagents-desktop/install.sh` inside `sync_resident()`, `ps -o comm= -p "$p"` returns the symlink name the daemon started through rather than the actual binary path it is running, so stale daemons are missed when the symlink is updated. Replace the `ps -o comm=` lookup with `lsof -a -p "$p" -d txt -Fn` parsed with `awk` to extract the first `n`-prefixed executable path. Verify with `bash -n apps/openagents-desktop/install.sh`.
